title: One spend ledger
description:
Generalise `AnnouncementSpend` into one ledger: a counter per scope and budget cycle (`ai:<site>`, `ai:<site>:<responsibility>`, `x:<account>`), added to atomically when a run or an attempt finishes. Per-run cost stays on the run record. An unpriced model is named and counted as unknown, never as free. The ledger holds numbers only.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Every paid run adds its cost to the site's cycle once.
- The X counter keeps working through the same ledger.
- A run with an unpriced model marks the cycle total as partial.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- spend-ledger.feature: a finished run adds its cost once; a redelivered wake does not add twice; an unpriced model marks the total partial; the X account's cycle total is unchanged by the move.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Amplify data: the ledger model (generalised from `AnnouncementSpend`).

**Part of:** Spend, budgets and model tiers. Slice code G1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started on the M3 (branch feat/PPY-fa165c-spend-ledger). Plan: a new SpendLedger model (scope + cycle id, atomic ADD of integer micro-dollars, an unpricedCalls counter for partial), a once-per-run marker written in the same transaction as the add, then X spend moved onto it. No in-place rename of AnnouncementSpend (that would drop its table); it is removed in a later release after the move.
